_comment: Files allowed to run processes, read or write files, open sockets or take IPC directly through Quickshell.Io (Process, FileView, Socket, IpcHandler, Quickshell.execDetached). This list only shrinks: these side effects are moving to the axiom daemon (the stages: docs/dev/backend/roadmap.md). New code goes through CommandManager, FileManager, StateManager, IpcTarget or the daemon. scripts/check_structure.py fails on a use not listed here and on an entry no longer used.
